verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents first-party ways to leave: one-click migration from Appwrite Cloud to a self-hosted instance (docs-43), self-hosting on any Docker host or Kubernetes (docs-68), and a dedicated native PostgreSQL option you connect to directly with psql, with backups and PITR (docs-8, docs-46). Data can therefore move to infrastructure you control or be reached through a standard open engine. Storage files are downloadable via API (docs-10), but there is no documented one-step 'export all data' feature producing open-format archives (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps of TablesDB rows, users, and files). Missing for 10: a dedicated full-account export tool, documented open export formats for managed databases/auth users, an exit path to non-Appwrite targets, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
